scope: Recorded proposal activation on captured live input only, not host execution or strength. Six frames of four live Immortal games that lost the original capital: Brazil civvis-20261115T222931Z t14 and t19 (Rome's city 7 tiles from Rio, 63/126 and 53/150 power; Rome declared t24), Sweden civvis-20261115T215049Z t24 and t38 (Australia's soldiers 1-3 tiles from Stockholm, none of its cities known, 34/69 and 78/168; declared t45), Brazil civvis-20261115T225515Z t21 (Khmer city 10 tiles out, 48/102; declared t63) and Sumer civvis-20261115T234712Z t17 (Zulu soldiers 1-3 tiles from Uruk, 48/182; Poland declared t70). Each run's events.jsonl is cut after turn T+1 and queried with --resumed on one release civvis_orders built from this branch (67713e494a). Both arms carry the run's own why.log header genome (`forced`, each as --with), victory lane and civilization; the on arm adds the gene. Off, no deterrent is trained on any frame (the opening window opens at t30; Australia and Zulu have no known city within ten tiles). On, the gene trains a Warrior, Slinger or Archer on every frame.
